title: Five new ways in: design a covenant, spot the rug, and more
body: The learn section gained a covenant design wizard — answer three plain questions and real Silverscript assembles itself, with all eight possible contracts compiled against silverc v1.0.0 and re-proven daily in CI. Alongside it: a spot-the-rug game about what covenants actually prevent, a five-years-in-one-slider timeline, a live covenant counter on the homepage, and a downloadable tour certificate you can timestamp on Kaspa itself via KasProof.

title: KCC-12 proposed: one wallet API for every Kaspa dApp
body: A new draft KCC proposes a common browser-wallet provider API — deliberately close to Ethereum's EIP-1193/6963 model (announce/request provider events, request({method}), familiar error codes) — so one dApp can talk to any Kaspa wallet without per-wallet integrations. This week's revision added PSKB support: partially-signed transaction bundles for multisig and covenant flows where a wallet signs only the inputs it controls. Caveats that matter: it is a draft under active review (16 review comments in its first two days), no wallet has adopted it yet, and it overlaps a separate KIP-12 wallet-discovery effort — which standard wallets converge on is the open question. This site now tracks the proposal daily on the status page.

title: State of the stack: live adoption numbers
body: The status page now leads with chain data refreshed daily from the keyless kcc20.info indexer — covenants created, state transitions, live KCC-20 tokens, and a 30-day activity chart. Plus: every trading venue, explorer and indexer now has its own ecosystem card.

title: kcc20-live: the first verified third-party Argent contract
body: A KCC-20 token written in Argent (.ag) by a third party builds cleanly with argentc in this site's CI — the first community Argent contract we have been able to verify. Argent itself still has no tagged release.

title: Silverscript v1.0.0 quietly broke most pre-1.0 community contracts
body: Compile-checking every known community contract library against v1.0.0 in fresh containers: OpenSilver (21 of 25 contracts), kosign, K100bet and kasmelt-snapshot — all written pre-release — no longer parse. Stateless contract styles survived; stateful ones did not. These repos are on the under-review list until they update, and the weekly re-check will notice the moment one does.

title: KCC-20's draft specification has a home: kccs.dev
body: Kaspa Calls for Conventions (kaspanet/kccs) hosts the draft fungible-token covenant specification, the covenant ABI and authority schemes. The KCC-20 component page now links it, and the spec repo is watched by the daily status data.

title: Silverscript v1.0.0 released — no external audit named
body: The covenant language hit its first tagged release, adding Groth16 and RISC Zero proof verifiers that lower to the KIP-16 opcode live on mainnet. Its own security policy still calls the project experimental, and no external audit has been named — maturity on this site remains pre-audit.

title: Toccata's inline ZK verification live on mainnet
body: KIP-16's OpZkPrecompile went live: Kaspa script can verify zero-knowledge proofs directly, meaning a covenant can require a valid proof before coins move.
